These queries are guesses. The page names only a few verbs (`doc`, `count`, `eq`, `gt`, `add`, `type`, `take`, `open`, `links`, `content`), so `filter`, `sortBy`, `groupBy`, `sum`, `round`, `lower` and the rest are assumed from convention. I couldn't check that any of them exist, and I used the `J` labels to match the task IDs.

J1: `/data | filter (/active | eq true) | filter (/address/city | type | eq ::Str) | sortBy (/name | lower) | * /name`
J2: `* (filter (/status | lower | eq "paid")) | filter (/status | lower | eq "paid") | * (/items * (/qty | mul /price)) | flatten | sum | round 2`
J3: `(/dependencies | merge /devDependencies) | entries | filter (/value | startsWith "^") | sortBy /key | * (/key | add "@" | add /value)`
J4: `filter (/state | eq "open") | groupBy (/assignee/login | default "unassigned") | mapVals count`
J5: `:d /defaults | /services | filter (/enabled | ne false) | * {:name /name :timeout (/timeout | default ~(/d/timeout)) :retries (/retries | default ~(/d/retries))} | sortBy /name`
J6: `filter (/durationMs | ne null) | groupBy /service | mapVals (* /durationMs | avg | round 1)`
J7: `filter (/stock | gt 0) | sortBy /price | reverse | take 3 | * /name`
J8: `groupBy /dept | mapVals (* (/skills | default []) | flatten | * lower | distinct | sort)`
J9: `filter (/role | lower | eq "db") | all (/region | eq "eu-west") and (/cpu/cores | gte 8)`
J10: `"Alice@Example.com, bob@test.org; carol@EXAMPLE.com, dave@mail.net; erin@Test.org, frank@example.com" | split #"[,;]\s*" * (split "@" | /1 | lower) | distinct | sort`
J11: `split "\n" | * (split " ") | filter (/3 | toNumber | gte 500) | groupBy /2 | mapVals count | entries | * {:path /key :count /value} | sortBy [(/count | neg) /path] | take 2`
J12: `split "\n" | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter (/2 | ne "") | groupBy /1 | mapVals (* (/2 | toNumber) | avg | round 2)`
J13: `split "\n" | filter (contains "==") | filter (startsWith "#" | not) | * (split "==") | * {:k (/0 | lower) :v /1} | toMap /k /v`
J14: `sortBy (/comments | default [] | * (/likes | default 0) | sum) | last | /title`
